currentSeats.label: Guild Master — Council Chair
currentSeats.description: The alliance Guild Master chairs common Council business while retaining the separate Leader classification. Chairing does not add another native rank or a second vote.

currentSeats.label: Co-Guild Master / Hand of the Sovereign
currentSeats.description: Alliance executive coordination, continuity and cross-branch liaison within the accepted remit. Vice Guild Master and Chief of Staff are not added to this remit by implication.

currentSeats.label: Lord High Treasurer / Imperial Exchequer
currentSeats.description: Alliance budgets, receipts and financial stewardship, with custody, spending approval and independent audit kept separate.

currentSeats.label: Lord High Chancellor / Head of Justice
currentSeats.description: The Lord High Chancellor is the High Council’s individual judicial portfolio holder. The Council of Justice and Privy Court remain institutions with separately designated hearing panels; holding this office is not a permanent seat on every case or a power to judge one’s own enforcement decision. Panel service gives no blanket Council vote, case access or enforcement power; each participant still needs case designation, relevant access and conflict review.

currentSeats.label: Grand Marshal of PvE
currentSeats.description: The Grand Marshal of PvE directs alliance-wide raid preparation. This is the main raid portfolio on the High Council, distinct from the NA and EU Raid Leaders who command their own scheduled teams.

currentSeats.label: Grand Marshal of PvP
currentSeats.description: The Grand Marshal of PvP coordinates voluntary battleground teams and world-PvP activity across Olympus. The office supplies strategy and reliable event leadership within a PvE guild; participation in PvP is never a condition of ordinary membership.

currentSeats.label: High Inquisitor / Minister of Internal Security
currentSeats.description: The High Inquisitor leads the preventive safety and conduct programme. The office helps the separately authorized moderation team detect abuse and preserve proportionate evidence; it does not decide its own contested appeals or create a right to inspect private messages.

currentSeats.label: High Minister of the Chancery & Imperial Census
currentSeats.description: Alliance admission standards, intake coordination and escalation, distinct from branch Recruiters and their local capacity decisions.

currentSeats.label: Grand Concordat Director
currentSeats.description: The Grand Concordat Director coordinates the ten sister branches while preserving each Guild Master’s local command. The office turns dated capacity evidence, branch contacts and member preferences into fair routing proposals; it cannot manufacture seats or issue automatic invitations.

currentSeats.label: Grand Master Artisan
currentSeats.description: Alliance profession policy, voluntary craft coordination and Workshop stewardship, with local suppliers and emissaries keeping their own remits.

currentSeats.label: High Architect of Systems
currentSeats.description: Alliance architecture, compatibility, privacy and recovery planning across the addon, website and Discord tools. Engineering support remains Officer Corps; the title grants no production or signing access.

currentSeats.label: Lord High Herald / Minister of Heraldry
currentSeats.description: Alliance identity, approved communications and publication standards, coordinated through responsible local editors and emissaries.

currentSeats.label: Head of Trading & Markets
currentSeats.description: A reserved High Council portfolio devoted solely to Auction House optimization, direct buy/sell negotiation and the market economy. The Treasurer authorizes capital and risk limits and retains custody; realized results and inventory are independently reviewable. No holder or access is granted by this reference.

nodes.title: Founder and Patron
nodes.remit: Reserved constitutional decisions and reasoned final authority.
nodes.limits: Ratification of this charter does not appoint any person, grant platform access or confer sovereignty outside the guild.

nodes.title: High Council
nodes.remit: Olympus-wide standards, budgets and portfolio coordination.
nodes.limits: Guild Master, Co-Guild Master and Treasurer form the core Council offices. An accepted warrant and eligible vote remain separate from native ranks and actual permissions.

nodes.title: Council of Justice
nodes.remit: Conduct, compliance, disputes and appeals through unconflicted panels.
nodes.limits: Case designation, recusal and actual moderation access are separate.

nodes.title: Co-Guild Master and Vice Guild Master
nodes.remit: Agendas, absence cover and liaison within an accepted warrant.
nodes.limits: Neither title is a native rank, automatic succession or command over other Guild Masters.

nodes.title: Chief of Staff
nodes.remit: Agendas, action register and delivery across portfolios.
nodes.limits: No assumption of reserved Founder powers or additional platform access.

nodes.title: Secretary and Registrar
nodes.remit: Maintain instruments, vacancies, minutes and appointment terms.
nodes.limits: May be combined with Chief of Staff; cannot manufacture approval or rewrite a decision.

nodes.title: Foreign affairs
nodes.remit: Agreed contacts and proposed cooperation through the Chief of Staff.
nodes.limits: Binding commitments require written delegation, not a title.

nodes.title: Department of War
nodes.remit: Shared PvP and raid standards, preparation and training.
nodes.limits: Portfolio coordination does not confer local guild or event command.

nodes.title: War Head for PvP
nodes.remit: PvP standards and coordination of PvP Emissaries.
nodes.limits: Local Captains lead only assigned activities.

nodes.title: War Head for Raiding
nodes.remit: Raid preparation and coordination of Raiding Emissaries.
nodes.limits: No automatic invitation, loot, bank or demotion powers.

nodes.title: Strategy and scouting
nodes.remit: Build research, encounter planning, permitted scouting and tested advice.
nodes.limits: Advice creates no compulsory play, account access or permission for personal surveillance.

nodes.title: Federal Treasury
nodes.remit: Dues accounting, approved budgets, receipts and Finance Emissaries.
nodes.limits: Treasurer is a High Council appointment associated with zero-based slot 1, not an extra native rank; bank permissions, custody and approval remain separate.

nodes.title: Trading & Markets
nodes.remit: Optimize permitted Auction House and direct-trade decisions through price research, disciplined inventory and realized net trading profit.
nodes.limits: Sole trading remit. Treasurer retains custody, approved capital and risk caps; independent audit remains separate. No dues, appeals, moderation, craft-commission management, paid rights or automatic access.

nodes.title: Association of Artisanry
nodes.remit: Crafting, willing suppliers and approved supply requests.
nodes.limits: Materials remain their owners’ property; no forced labour or bank access by title.

nodes.title: Department of Heraldry
nodes.remit: Approved announcements, events, recruitment communications and participation.
nodes.limits: Publicity needs verified facts and appropriate consent.

nodes.title: Intake and recruitment
nodes.remit: Application pipeline, capacity contacts, verification readiness and review dates.
nodes.limits: No independent blacklist, finding of guilt or bypass of game verification.

nodes.title: Media and communications
nodes.remit: Approved news, permitted content and local media liaison.
nodes.limits: No private cases, chat logs or financial receipts in publicity.

nodes.title: Events and training
nodes.remit: Calendar coordination, inclusive events, willing mentors and skill clinics.
nodes.limits: No compulsory attendance, new Training rank or unapproved resource allocation.

nodes.title: Systems and Addons Division
nodes.remit: Systems Architect portfolio, addon engineering and technical support within individually accepted warrants.
nodes.limits: The architect portfolio is classified with High Council; engineering support is Officer Corps. Neither classification appoints a holder or grants signing, platform or bank access.

nodes.title: Independent Bank Auditor
nodes.remit: Review records and report to Council or an unconflicted authority.
nodes.limits: Cannot audit their own custody or hold withdrawal/payment approval over audited assets.

nodes.title: Affiliated Guild Masters • I–X placeholders
nodes.remit: Each Guild Master runs their guild and answers to Founder and Council for common obligations.
nodes.limits: Ten directory slots are unappointed placeholders, not a claim that ten formed guilds exist.

nodes.title: Officer Corps and Officer Alt appointments
nodes.kind: Officer Corps native ranks and delegated duties
nodes.remit: Local leadership delegated by that guild’s Guild Master.
nodes.limits: Officer is Rank 3 slot 2; Officer Alt is Rank 4 slot 3. Actual permissions require a current warrant; an alternate creates no second person or vote.

nodes.title: Five per-guild emissary liaisons
nodes.remit: Connect a participating guild with each core portfolio.
nodes.limits: Local delegation remains controlling; no unilateral commitment or replacement of event command.

nodes.title: Emissary of War • PvP
nodes.remit: Link local PvP activity to the PvP War Head.
nodes.limits: Participation remains locally approved.

nodes.title: Emissary of War • Raiding
nodes.remit: Share preparation and event plans with the Raiding War Head.
nodes.limits: Does not replace the local Raid Leader’s named command.

nodes.title: Emissary of Finance
nodes.remit: Approved financial summaries, dues and custody liaison.
nodes.limits: Bank custody and audit remain separate.

nodes.title: Emissary of Artisanry
nodes.remit: Bring local crafting and material needs to Artisanry.
nodes.limits: Cannot requisition private resources.

nodes.title: Emissary of Heraldry
nodes.remit: Verified local news and approved event publicity.
nodes.limits: Communications duties are not extra native officer ranks.

nodes.title: Local raid and PvP appointments
nodes.remit: Named Raid Leaders, Raid Assistants, Marshals and PvP Captains lead bounded activities.
nodes.limits: Raid Leader is a native slot; event command is separately assigned and gives no general guild or bank authority.

nodes.title: Quartermaster and bank custody
nodes.remit: Issue approved supplies and maintain stock and receipt records.
nodes.limits: Bank Manager and Bank Steward are aliases; custody cannot audit itself.

nodes.title: Local recruitment and trial support
nodes.remit: Recruiters and Trial Officers explain expectations and arrange reviews and mentorship.
nodes.limits: Missing information is not fabricated misconduct.

nodes.title: Local community, events and media
nodes.remit: Inclusive onboarding, local events and permitted news or content.
nodes.limits: No staff access or control of play hours by title.

nodes.title: Class Heads and mentors
nodes.remit: Advice for Warrior, Paladin, Hunter, Rogue, Priest, Mage, Warlock, Shaman and Druid; support for Initiates.
nodes.limits: Expertise is an appointment, not another native rank or an already implemented AddOn badge.

nodes.title: Welfare and community support
nodes.remit: Explain options and connect local support contacts, with an independent route into Justice.
nodes.limits: No clinical claim; support conversations are not evidence of misconduct.

nodes.title: Membership, tags and review states
nodes.remit: The administrative rank ladder is separate from the reporting structure.
nodes.limits: Tags and review states create no native powers, votes or access.

nodes.title: Ten native rank slots
nodes.remit: Exactly ten administrative character rank slots, described in Article S3.
nodes.limits: A configuration preset changes no live rank, bank amount or permission.

nodes.title: Activity and courtesy tags
nodes.remit: Social play, crafting, raid participation and voluntary descriptions.
nodes.limits: No inferior standing or compulsory attendance; Treasury Tiers do not buy office, votes or powers.

nodes.title: Introduction and review statuses
nodes.remit: Introductory reviews and authorized case statuses with scope and review date.
nodes.limits: A Muted or hold label does not itself change permissions; appeal remains available.

nodes.title: Honorary and advisory recognition
nodes.remit: Recognition for past service and scoped current advice.
nodes.limits: No automatic access, vote, bank rights or moderation powers.

nodes.title: Internal Security
nodes.remit: Preventive safety, incident triage and conduct enforcement through separately authorized moderators.
nodes.limits: Publication grants no appointment, native rank, permissions or operational activation.

nodes.title: Grand Alliance Concordat
nodes.remit: Cross-branch coordination, dated capacity evidence and fair Main/Alt routing across Olympus I–X.
nodes.limits: Publication grants no appointment, native rank, permissions or operational activation.

adoption.basis: explicit owner authorization to adopt the guild rules

officeMandates.title: Co-Guild Master
officeMandates.duty: Coordinates the duties delegated by the Founder and resolves cross-guild dependencies.
officeMandates.output: A current action register and reasoned escalations.
officeMandates.boundary: Existing website appointment is distinct; reserved powers are not silently transferred.

officeMandates.title: Vice Guild Master
officeMandates.duty: Provides expressly assigned continuity and absence cover.
officeMandates.output: A cover plan identifying when acting authority begins and ends.
officeMandates.boundary: No automatic succession or permanent delegation.

officeMandates.title: Chief of Staff
officeMandates.duty: Owns meeting preparation, action follow-up and portfolio handoffs.
officeMandates.output: Agenda, implementation owners, review dates and unresolved decisions.
officeMandates.boundary: Coordinates officers; does not invent command over local Guild Masters.

officeMandates.title: Secretary and Registrar
officeMandates.duty: Maintains accepted warrants, minutes, vacancies and versioned decisions.
officeMandates.output: Dated register entries and visible corrections.
officeMandates.boundary: Cannot create approval or fill a missing signature.

officeMandates.title: War Head for PvP
officeMandates.duty: Coordinates shared readiness, PvP emissaries and legitimate operational planning.
officeMandates.output: Readiness brief, participating guild agreement and post-operation lessons.
officeMandates.boundary: A local Captain commands only the named event; chart references do not appoint a holder.

officeMandates.title: War Head for Raiding
officeMandates.duty: Coordinates raid standards, emissaries, encounter research and training.
officeMandates.output: Published preparation standards and event reviews.
officeMandates.boundary: Local Raid Leaders own their events; no implicit loot, bank or demotion power.

officeMandates.title: Federal Treasurer
officeMandates.duty: Reconciles actual receipts, agreed budgets and finance correspondence.
officeMandates.output: Aggregate budget, commitments and reconciliation exceptions.
officeMandates.boundary: Treasurer is an appointed High Council office associated with Rank 2, zero-based slot 1, not a separate native rank; the holder never independently audits their own custody.

officeMandates.title: Minister of Artisanry
officeMandates.duty: Coordinates willing crafters, supply requests and approved procurement.
officeMandates.output: Confirmed craft requests, material ownership and delivery commitments.
officeMandates.boundary: No forced free labour, ownership of private materials or bank access by title.

officeMandates.title: Minister of Heraldry
officeMandates.duty: Coordinates the welcome, calendar, recruitment communication and public voice.
officeMandates.output: Verified notices, event owners and clear member handoffs.
officeMandates.boundary: Confidential cases and private financial details stay outside publicity.

officeMandates.title: Council of Justice
officeMandates.duty: Provides unconflicted case panels and independent appeal review.
officeMandates.output: Reasoned decisions, recusals, correction and appeal routes.
officeMandates.boundary: Default Council membership does not itself designate a case panel or grant moderation powers.

officeMandates.title: Independent Bank Auditor
officeMandates.duty: Examines relevant records independently of custody and approval.
officeMandates.output: Exceptions and recommendations to the unconflicted reviewing authority.
officeMandates.boundary: Actual withdrawal, custody or approval rights over audited assets must be reconciled first.

officeMandates.title: Technical Lead and Systems Architect
officeMandates.duty: Coordinates AddOn, website, Discord and operating-tool maintainers.
officeMandates.output: Reviewed artifacts, release outcomes, access inventories and recovery limits.
officeMandates.boundary: An office grants no credential or production access; local checks are not live proof.

officeMandates.title: Chief Strategist and Head of Research
officeMandates.duty: Develops tested recommendations and states version and uncertainty.
officeMandates.output: Versioned plans, methods and useful lessons.
officeMandates.boundary: Advice does not override the named event commander.

officeMandates.title: Intelligence and Scouting Lead
officeMandates.duty: Filters relevant permitted in-game observations.
officeMandates.output: Timely observations with source limits and confidence.
officeMandates.boundary: No harassment, exploitation, private surveillance or real-world targeting.

officeMandates.title: Diplomatic Envoy / Ambassador
officeMandates.duty: Maintains agreed external contacts and proposes cooperation.
officeMandates.output: Written terms and a decision returned to competent authority.
officeMandates.boundary: Binding commitments require a specific written delegation.

officeMandates.title: Chief of Intake and Recruitment Lead
officeMandates.duty: Keeps applications moving between applicant, local Recruiter and reviewer.
officeMandates.output: Named contact, next step, required information and review date.
officeMandates.boundary: An application acceptance is not an invitation, verified link or staff appointment.

officeMandates.title: Media and Communications Lead
officeMandates.duty: Checks facts, consent and format for approved public notices.
officeMandates.output: Dated issue, confirming source and visible corrections.
officeMandates.boundary: No private evidence or invented appointment announcements.

officeMandates.title: Events Lead

officeMandates.output: Owner, capacity, time zone, joining and cancellation instructions.
officeMandates.boundary: The event owner retains operational responsibility; reminders need actual consent.

officeMandates.title: Academy and Training Lead

officeMandates.output: Agreed support goals and useful material.
officeMandates.boundary: No compulsory play hours or extra native Training rank.
